# PowerPlay v2.0.1 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Update the default PowerPlay artwork to the approved Wave + Circuit logo: softened triangular corners, white left-biased P, flowing interior layers, and circuit traces inside the lightning bolt.
- Restore one **diagonal cyan → blue → violet → magenta gradient** throughout the play outline, wave fill and circuit bolt. No heartbeat or pulse motif.
- Regenerate the default Android/Fire TV launcher, theme-friendly splash, adaptive icons, notification glyphs and Android TV banners from a coordinated vector master.
- Refresh all 23 alternate launcher themes and their Android, iOS, tvOS assets without changing existing saved icon IDs.
- Replace the README banner/icon, repository brand exports, website sharing image and companion platform graphic assets.
- Preserve PowerShuffle queues, PowerLink pairing, ExoPlayer playback, deep links and the existing Android application ID.

## Compatibility

No intentionally breaking changes. Existing PowerPlay 2.0.0 installations can update in place using the same signing identity. The feature and pairing requirements for PowerLink remain unchanged.
